title: STANDING IN THE STORM
ACTS 27 MIDNIGHT PRAYER
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight

scenes.a: The violent storm around you will not quiet.
scenes.sub: WHEN THE WIND WILL NOT QUIET

scenes.a: Yet in this dark hour, heaven sends word to your weary heart.
For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve, Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.
Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
scenes.sub: IT SHALL BE AS HE PROMISED

scenes.a: Lord, stand by us in this midnight watch and anchor our souls in Your promises.
Amen, though the violent storm around you will not quiet.
